name: daily-command-center
description: Every morning Claude asks for the three tasks you need to do today, then pins them in a side pane next to your revenue and key numbers.

start_hour.title: Start hour
start_hour.description: The hour (0 to 23, your local time) from which Claude asks for your three tasks. 9 is 9am.

stripe_key.title: Stripe key
stripe_key.description: Optional. A Stripe restricted key with read access to Balance, to show revenue today and month to date. Leave empty for no Stripe.

metrics_command.title: Metrics command
metrics_command.description: Optional. A shell command that prints one 'Label: value' line per number to show. Leave empty for none.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Check-off sound volume, from 0 (silent) to 4 (loud). 1 is normal.
